clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Military Ward, Sara Balloo mourns her husband Sully and holds fast to the words he left behind.

Sara Balloo keeps vigil in Ironforge's Military Ward, amid the clang of weapons and the drill of soldiers. Her husband, Sully Balloo, fell in battle far from home, leaving her alone with grief and memories. A final letter, carried across the mountains from where he died, gives Sara words from his last days and a measure of closure.
